content.scenario: A person is convicted of manufacturing and selling adulterated products, and the court suspends their licence for two years.
content.outcome: The court has the power to suspend the licence for a period up to two years in case of first conviction, and cancel the licence in case of second or subsequent conviction, under the relevant provisions of the Act.

user_queries: What are the powers of the court in relation to offences under the Act?
Can the court suspend a licence for manufacturing and selling adulterated products?
What is the consequence of subsequent convictions for the same offence?
